answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the delta band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 156 to 333 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the reef identity is graded at all. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the vault audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
